mechanisms.rule: The base value is the return of a family fetch and the operand offset is the declared dispatch slot named by an OSSL_FUNC_* id.
refusals: base is not the family fetch return or has an unknown merge
offset is outside the declared dispatch stride
no OSSL_FUNC_* id names the slot
the source has more than one assignment or it is not the family from_algorithm
the object could be an in-image legacy method table

mechanisms.rule: The operand is exactly entry parameter N of a symbol present in .dynsym, and the header declares that parameter as a callback typedef.
refusals: the value is not a single linear provenance from the entry parameter
the root symbol is absent from .dynsym
the header declares a non-callback parameter
no exported root exists; the site defers to reachable-caller-target when the caller set is finite and in-image

mechanisms.rule: A stack/closure slot is assigned only from lea-of-function-start at an enumerated set of sites on every path.
refusals: any path leaves the slot unwritten
any store is not a function start
the reached set is empty or outside start_set
